notes: Cutter Street is printed CUTTER (PARK). Barr Alley is printed BARREL (BARR) ALLEY, 10', Cutter to Mound only (no opening on the east side of Mound); it lines up with Barr Alley on sheet 21, so Cutter/Barr is a cross. Sweeney Alley is printed SWEENEY (AVERY ALLEY), 20'. Mound (50') runs W 6th to W 5th; north of W 6th it continues on the sheet-42/41 outlines, wider and angled NNE (centre ~2093 at y 700), so the W 6th crossing is the four-corner centre. Smith: the outline blocks north of W 6th sit ~40 px west of the drawn faces south of it (water pipe is straight at x~3760); the W 6th point is the four-corner centre. Smith is 40' (faces 3690/3834) north of W 5th and 50' (3641/3820) south of it; the W 5th point is the four-corner centre. Cutter south of W 5th: east side = sheet-22 blocks (Oscar Onken Co. at the W 4th corner), west side = sheet-21 outlines. The open strip at y~2005-2055 east of Mound (block 4) is rear yards, not an alley. W 4th: south side is sheet 9/10 outlines; centre taken midway (pipe agrees).
